title: Random Pullback Attractors and Numerical Approximation for Nonlocal Lattice Delay Equations Driven by Rough Noise
summary: We investigate the pathwise asymptotic dynamics of a nonlocal lattice equation with fixed delay on $\ell^2(\mathbb Z)$ driven by an infinite-dimensional stationary weakly geometric rough path. Using a rough-flow Doss-Sussmann transformation and the method of steps, we establish global well-posedness in the controlled-path framework and construct a continuous random dynamical system.
